title: Place inference where the contract can survive
description: Choose a workload, execution tier, hardware profile, uplink, and privacy boundary. The lab admits the placement only when latency, memory, accelerator, bandwidth, privacy, and disconnected-operation gates all clear.
modelNote: This deterministic teaching model uses declared service times and capacities. It is useful for comparing constraints, not benchmarking a real device.

workloads.label: Safety interlock
workloads.detail: Detect a hazardous machine state and trigger a bounded local response.

workloads.label: Quality inspection
workloads.detail: Classify parts on a production line before the next station.

workloads.label: Store analytics
workloads.detail: Aggregate non-identifying occupancy events for hourly planning.

placements.label: Device
placements.detail: Run beside the sensor. Lowest network dependency, smallest resource envelope.

placements.label: Site edge
placements.detail: Share accelerators inside one facility while keeping raw data on site.

placements.label: Cloud
placements.detail: Use elastic compute, but pay the full network path and cloud dependency.

nodes.label: Smart camera
nodes.detail: 1.5 GB free memory, 4 TOPS accelerator, ONNX opset 18 runtime.

nodes.label: Industrial gateway
nodes.detail: 6 GB free memory, 18 TOPS accelerator, ONNX opset 20 runtime.

nodes.label: Edge rack
nodes.detail: 24 GB free memory, 80 TOPS aggregate capacity, ONNX opset 21 runtime.

nodes.label: Cloud accelerator pool
nodes.detail: Elastic memory and accelerator quota with ONNX opset 21 runtime.

links.label: Managed WAN
links.detail: 80 Mbps usable uplink, 34 ms round trip, site and cloud reachable.

links.label: Constrained cellular
links.detail: 12 Mbps usable uplink, 96 ms round trip, variable cloud path.

links.label: Cloud partition
links.detail: The facility network is healthy, but the cloud control plane is unreachable.

links.label: Site isolated
links.detail: Only the device-local path remains. Site and cloud services are unavailable.

privacyPolicies.label: Raw data stays on device
privacyPolicies.detail: Only decisions, counters, and bounded diagnostics may leave the sensor.

privacyPolicies.label: Raw data stays on site
privacyPolicies.detail: Device and site-edge processing are allowed; cloud receives derived telemetry.

privacyPolicies.label: Approved cloud transfer
privacyPolicies.detail: The workload is approved to send raw input to all three tiers.
